title: A Fan-Shaped Polynuclear Gd6Cu12 Amino Acid Cluster: A “Hollow” and Ferromagnetic [Gd6(μ3-OH)8] Octahedral Core Encapsulated by Six [Cu2] Glycinato Blade Fragments

material_class.structural_family: axial-fan Gd6Cu12 glycinato cluster with a hollow [Gd6(μ3-OH)8] octahedral core and an isolated [Gd(H2O)8]3+ counterion

synthesis.procedure: To an aqueous solution (10 mL) of Gd(ClO4)3·6H2O (1.127 g, 2 mmol), Cu(ClO4)2·6H2O and glycine were added at a Gd3+/Cu2+/Gly ratio of 2:1:2. The pH was adjusted to about 6.6 with 0.1 M NaOH. After stirring for 2 h, the solution was filtered and placed in a desiccator containing phosphorus pentoxide. A colorless solid precipitated after about one month. The mixture was then left in air, and blue crystals of 1 formed after about two weeks. The crystals were filtered, washed with cold water, and dried in air. Yield: 0.17 g, 36.9%. The prior precipitation of the colorless solid is required; it is described as a probable Gd-oxo perchlorate that templates further aggregation.
synthesis.time: 2 h stirring; colorless solid after about 1 month; blue crystals after about 2 weeks in air
synthesis.vessel_or_method: aqueous solution, filtration, phosphorus pentoxide desiccator, then standing in air
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration followed by slow precipitation in a P2O5 desiccator, then crystallization in air; crystals filtered, washed with cold water, and air-dried.

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows overall ferromagnetism with a positive Weiss constant, strong antiferromagnetic Cu–Cu coupling within the [Cu2] blades, ferromagnetic Cu–Gd coupling, and very weak ferromagnetic Gd–Gd coupling in the hollow [Gd6] core. At low field it behaves as a frustrated ferrimagnet; at high field the Cu spins pair and Gd3+ single-ion behavior is observed. The [Gd6] core is described as the first high-nuclearity Lnn (n ≥ 3) oxo cluster with molecular ferromagnetism.
